project_name: MatchPrep AI - Medical Residency Interview Coach

theme.aesthetic: Pink but Professional (Elevated Medical Rose & Slate Architecture)
theme.description: A refined, trustworthy $20/mo subscription SaaS design pairing sophisticated deep berry/rose accents (#BE123C, #E11D48) with ultra-clean medical slate neutrals (#0F172A, #F8FAFC) and delicate warm blush surfaces (#FFF1F2, #FCE7F3). Avoids child-like pinks; exudes high-performance clinical authority with supportive warmth.

scale.section_h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900
scale.subtitle: text-base sm:text-lg text-slate-600 font-normal leading-relaxed

five_tabs.label: Dashboard
five_tabs.description: Interview countdown clock, today's 5-min practice streak, readiness score radial, quick mock interview trigger.

five_tabs.label: Practice
five_tabs.description: Realistic Mock Interview Mode (Voice AI, 6 Interviewer Personalities), SARR Answer Framework Coach, Speech & Video Analysis.

five_tabs.label: Programs
five_tabs.description: Program-Specific Prep, Know This Program cards, Why Us builder, Questions YOU Should Ask library.

five_tabs.label: Progress
five_tabs.description: 7-Category Readiness Analytics (Content, Conciseness, Confidence, Specialty, Program, Behavioral, Body Language), Spaced Repetition queue.

five_tabs.label: My Story
five_tabs.description: CV / ERAS Application Builder, USMLE scores, Experiences, Personal Statement uploader, Auto-question generator.

answer_framework_sarr.ui_style: Color-coded breakdown cards with live AI highlighter and progress percentage indicators.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='tab-dashboard', data-testid='start-mock-interview-button', data-testid='personality-warm-pd').
Use standard Tailwind rose and slate palettes (#E11D48 primary, #FFF1F2 blush accents, #0F172A headers). Do NOT use generic purple/indigo or childish bright pink.
Mock Interview Mode MUST include full voice/audio visualizer waves, live transcript simulation, start/stop recording, camera feed window with real-time posture/eye contact overlays.
SARR Answer Framework Coach should render student responses split into Situation, Action, Reflection, and Relevance with scores and improvement suggestions.
Include a simulated consent modal for video/audio feedback as specified in requirements.
In My Story tab, allow CV/ERAS upload simulation, USMLE Step 1/2 score badges, research items, and instant 'Generate Practice Questions' action.
Provide a simulated $20/month subscription upgrade drawer/modal or badge showing Active Residency Pro Membership.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy (p-6, p-8 for containers).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.contrast: All text must meet APCA / WCAG AA standard against white/rose-blush backgrounds.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.micro_interactions: Smooth hover states on cards, pill buttons with shadow-md on primary actions, scale-95 on click.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.testing_attributes: MUST add data-testid to every button, input, tab, card action, and score display.
